sections.title: About this guide
data: Station Sturgeon Bay is a small-boat station of Sector Lake Michigan on the canal that joins Green Bay to Lake Michigan. The home count comes from the Coast Guard's housing map; the unit facts come from the station's official page, read through search results.
Ask your sponsor before you move.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists 16 active homes at the Sturgeon Bay housing site.

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
